page0.text:
That is...
The answer her Master arrived at.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page0:1

page1.text:
...
Her anger dissolves.
All she can do is stare at her Master, her words dying on her lips.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page1:1

page2.text:
"This path..."
"Everything about me...I don't believe it's wrong."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page2:1

page3.text:
Despite his maimed body...
As he struggles even to breathe...
As he sheds the tears of one so horribly grieved...
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page3:1

page4.text: "I can't stray from this path, for all those who were left behind, who laid it."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page4:1

page5.text: Apologizing to those he must climb over, but unwavering in his chosen path.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page5:1

page6.text:
...
Her vision wavers.
Her breath quivers.
She knows his history.
Just as he saw visions of her past, so she saw his.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page6:1

page7.text:
She was certain he would agree.
No, she thought he had to.
She'd meant to say, "It's not your fault," but the words died on her lips.
If only he could hear it, she wanted to tell him he should not have to carry that weight.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page7:1

page8.text:
But he denies even that.
No matter how tragic the past...
...one cannot undo it.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page8:1

page9.text:
...
Her legs nearly give out beneath her.
His words are a greater weight than even she can bear.
To swear an oath and single-mindedly devote everything to carrying it out.
She believed they were similar.
How conceited.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page9:1

page10.text:
That was her great mistake.
They were nothing alike.
His resolve was so, so strong.
And she, who could not even believe his words, was weak...
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page10:1

page11.text:
"You would choose your own selfish wish over salvation."
The priest releases the boy.
He steps over the youth with a sneer, as if he's lost interest.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page11:1

page12.text:
"Then what say you, Saber?
This boy says he does not need the Holy Grail. I am quite certain you disagree. Your goal must be to use the Grail to save the world in some capacity. A Heroic Spirit such as yourself is surely not so self-centered as that child."
She feels her sense of reason is being imperiled.
The priest says he will give her the Grail.
He will give her what she desires. Her wish, granted.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page12:1

page13.text:
"Th-that..."
She has no reason to refuse.
That is the miracle she's been fighting for.
It is the very reason she became a Servant.
What Shirou said has no bearing on her own concerns.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page13:1

page14.text:
To obtain the Holy Grail, she, Saber, the hero of the sword—
"I propose an exchange.
Saber, kill your Master. With your own hands, you will have taken hold of your desire. I will give you the Holy Grail if you do this."
I decided I would do anything for it.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page14:1

page15.text:
"What...?"
His words blindside her.
She doesn't even know what to think.
The priests words, while easy to understand, are anathema to everything she believes in and stands for.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page15:1

page16.text:
"Hm? Why hesitate? You could kill him before he even realized what happened.
He is clearly beyond saving. Would killing him now not be a mercy?"
The priest steps aside.
Before her stands a door leading to the crypt, and to her Master.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page16:1

page17.text:
"N......"
She steps into the damp room, past the priest.
She can't help herself.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page17:1

page18.text:
...
It's as if she's stepped into the depths of hell.
He was made to suffer in this place, to witness his own darkness.
But...he refused the salvation he was offered.
...
She grips her sword.
He lays at her feet, breathing raggedly.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page18:1

page19.text:
...
It would be the end of a long, long journey.
The Holy Grail she desires, in exchange for her life.
All she must do is swing her sword but one final time.
A Master and Servant are united only until they obtain the Grail.
She could end it right here.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-20:page19:1
